correctness.rationale: The exact stationary monomial recursion follows by applying L=(-mu*x+kappa*y)∂x +D∂yy +r[f(x,0)-f(x,y)]; its quadratic h solves -Lh=x²-M20. Stationary Green–Kubo 2E[(x²-M20)h] and direct carré-du-champ 2D(Bx+2Cy)²+r(Bxy+Cy²)² give equal long-time rates, martingale CLT follows from ergodicity, bounded polynomial moments and Lindeberg. Matched OU covariance is identical because E[Y0Yt]=2D/r exp(-rt); Gaussian Wick integration gives SigmaG, with explicitly positive excess 8D²κ⁴(21r²+24rmu+8mu²)/[mu²r³(r+mu)³(r+2mu)]. The ratio derivative is negative using a stated globally positive polynomial. Independently computed unit rates Sigma_reset=68/3 and SigmaG=5 and checked derivative identity.
residual_risks: Stationary process, positive rates, Brownian resets of forcing but no resets of position, Gaussian comparator matched only in second-order covariance. Ratio endpoints 5 and 1 are limiting unattained values; degenerate D or coupling excluded.
